about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-04 from the fork's main at about 1% over the measured size. 2026-11-05: lazy raised from 3055000 to 3055261 (measured 3055251 at 2f33440): #208 added 229 B of lazy JS (call sites for the deferred heli load; boot and entry did not change) and later PRs the rest. 2026-11-06: lazy raised from 3055261 to 3055692 (measured 3055682 after merging main at c32d299 into #218): #218 moves the ?fly camera from boot into the lazy dev-probes chunk, where it compresses worse than it did inside boot (lazy +421 B, entry and boot -115 B); no behaviour-neutral dev-only trim of that size was found.
